payloads.name: ps5-fan-control
payloads.description: Small PS5 daemon payload ELF that sets the system fan temperature.

payloads.name: fan_target_85c
payloads.description: fan_target keeps the PS5 fan controller at a selected target temperature while leaving the console's automatic fan control enabled.
